    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Every weekday morning">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">0 0 9 ? * MON-FRI</bpmn:timeCycle>

      <bpmn:task id="a_register" name="Register all defaulting accounts and customers" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="a_g3" name="Defaulting client codes previously advised?" default="af11" />
      <bpmn:task id="a_produce" name="Produce table of defaulting accounts" />
      <bpmn:task id="a_send_am" name="Send to account management" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="a_mg3" name="Merge" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="a_mg2" name="Merge" />

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af5" name="Yes" sourceRef="a_g1" targetRef="a_mg1" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af6" sourceRef="a_check_crm1" targetRef="a_g2" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af7" name="Yes" sourceRef="a_g2" targetRef="a_register" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af8" name="No" sourceRef="a_g2" targetRef="a_mg2" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af9" sourceRef="a_register" targetRef="a_g3" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af10" name="No" sourceRef="a_g3" targetRef="a_produce" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af11" name="Yes" sourceRef="a_g3" targetRef="a_mg3" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af12" sourceRef="a_produce" targetRef="a_send_am" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af13" sourceRef="a_send_am" targetRef="a_mg3" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af14" sourceRef="a_mg3" targetRef="a_mg2" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af15" sourceRef="a_mg2" targetRef="a_mg1" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="af16" sourceRef="a_mg1" targetRef="a_end" />

        <bpmn:timeDate xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">2024-01-01T14:30:00</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="b_mg4" name="Merge" />

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="bf1" sourceRef="b_start" targetRef="b_check_crm2" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="bf2" sourceRef="b_check_crm2" targetRef="b_g4" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="bf3" name="Yes" sourceRef="b_g4" targetRef="b_reconcile" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="bf4" name="No" sourceRef="b_g4" targetRef="b_mg4" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="bf5" sourceRef="b_reconcile" targetRef="b_mg4" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="bf6" sourceRef="b_mg4" targetRef="b_end" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="b2" name="4:00 PM deadline" cancelActivity="false" attachedToRef="sub2">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDate xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">2024-01-01T16:00:00</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="msg_end" name="Message sent" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="final_end" name="Process completed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="tf3" sourceRef="b1" targetRef="alert_task" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="tf4" sourceRef="alert_task" targetRef="alert_end" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="tf5" sourceRef="b2" targetRef="msg_task" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="tf6" sourceRef="msg_task" targetRef="msg_end" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="tf7" sourceRef="sub2" targetRef="final_end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
